work.name: Wolt

Implemented the address-entry flow for Japan, using postcode lookup.
Owned a large-scale renewal of the iOS store page, focusing on the scrolling experience and store header.
Implemented Google Consent Mode and marketing-consent handling, including consent sync across the apps.
Automated regression tests for the onboarding flow with Maestro.
Added European Accessibility Act support in the app for search, discovery, and address entry.
Developed the category page, where users browse restaurants, groceries, and retail by category, with filters and a product-first view across nearby stores.
Operated and maintained Wolt's backend-driven UI rendering engine.
Built an experimental iOS frontend for an AI grocery-assistant chatbot.
